purpose: Learn one dictionary-conditioned execution rule and directly reuse it in untrained target dictionaries
scope: Existing source1, three fixed functions and exposed R26 development sentences. Shared rule trains on target2/3. Target4/5 are excluded from optimization; they remain development dictionary holdouts. All SAE and LM parameters stay unchanged.
budget: Representative smoke at most240 seconds and shared-rule development at most1560 seconds,14GB VRAM,1GB bulk. Original dictionaries and source-information interface remain fixed.
primary_endpoint: Seven unseen-request source-effect-normalized response RMSE, averaged across the three fixed functions and the two target dictionaries excluded from optimization. Development adoption comparison to the identity-weight recurrence and original tangent, with specialized program and readout shown as reference methods.
